en:
Mooorning, sleepyhead!
You're finally up, Shuichi.
Huh? What...?

Nee-heehee, are you gonna ask...
"Who am I?" and "Where am I?"

Well, you're definitely Shuichi Saihara.
And this place is...
Hmmm...I guess, hell.
Hell...?

<CLT=cltMIND>I shook my head, confused.
I looked around...
I-Is this...?

Oh, you're awake? This is the 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Entomologist<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s research lab.

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Entomologist<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s lab?
Why...?

Ah, I remember!
I was attacked by Gonta, and then...

The same is true of the rest of us. We were 
all seized by Gonta...and brought here.

But Shuichi's the only one who got
knocked out.
Gonta apologized for that.

Apparently he couldn't slow down in time
when he tried to grab you.

What is this anyway...?
Why did Gonta do this?

It's...because of that guy.
He was provoked by...that guy.

<CLT=cltMIND>My eyes followed where Tsumugi
was pointing...

There's no use trying to escape.
Gonta will just catch you again.

Is this your doing, Kokichi?
Did you have Gonta kidnap us?
Nee-heehee... He's so simple-minded.

As soon as I told him that everyone who
hates bugs was trying to get rid of them...

...he started crying and said that he would get
you guys to love bugs...or something like that.

And that's why we're all here! Welcome to the
mandatory <CLT=cltSTRONG>Insect Meet and Greet<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Oh, Gonta thought up the name, so if you
don't like it, voice your complaints to him!
You're terrible... You tricked Gonta.

Isn't it great!? Only an evil supreme leader
like me could do something so...eeeeeevil!
Kokichi...why are you doing this?

Oh, I thought we could throw ourselves a
little screening party with all our videos.

With all you here, exchanging our <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive videos<CLT=cltNORMAL>
wouldn't be that difficult at all...

And I wanna see your videos, too, so I figured
we could all binge-watch them together!

D-Do you know what will happen if you
do that?

Ummm... Everyone will know their <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL> and
a killing will be more likely to happen?

But I like playing on Mean difficulty. Also, I
don't <CLT=cltSTRONG>run<CLT=cltNORMAL> from battles in RPGs, either!

I wanna win this killing game! So I'm not gonna
run from it, I'm gonna crush it!
That'll be waaaay less boring, don'tcha think?
What the hell does that mean!?

I tried to warn you guys... I told you that we
shouldn't <CLT=cltSTRONG>cooperate<CLT=cltNORMAL> with each other.

Plus, if I'm gonna do this, then I gotta enjoy
myself and just go all the way.

If the thought of playing a <CLT=cltSTRONG>death game<CLT=cltNORMAL> doesn't
excite you, you'll never win. Understand?

<CLT=cltMIND>Strangely, I could detect no evil in
his smile as he said that.

<CLT=cltMIND>It was an innocent smile,
like a frolicking child.

<CLT=cltMIND>Although, perhaps...
it's just another <CLT=cltSTRONG>lie<CLT=cltMIND>.

Thank you for waiting!
Gonta bring Himiko and Angie!
Huh? Himiko and Angie, too?

Awww, man... And I was about to take a
break, too. I just finished all the prepwork...
Nyeeeh... What's the meaning of this?

Himiko, are you okay? My saliva makes
injuries heal faster.

Does your face hurt? Do you want me to
spit on your face and make it feel better?
No...

Hey, Gonta... Are these the only ones you
brought back from the gym?

Oh... Kirumi at gym but she tell Gonta she
too busy...
Hm...? And you just...let her go?

Atua says Kirumi fulfills any <CLT=cltSTRONG>request<CLT=cltNORMAL>
someone makes of her. Like a mommy.

Ah, she's not a mom, though...
Wait, what request?

I requested that she sew the curtains.
I don't think even Gonta can disturb her.

Sorry... Not even Gonta strong enough to
overcome Kirumi...

Hmmm, well, I guess at least one of you is
worthy of being called an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

Welp, nothing we can do about her...
Are the others still hiding somewhere?

Oh, Gonta see Miu, but...Gonta's face get
red-hot. So...Gonta no could bring her...

Your face got hot? You mean you were
hot on her trail, right?

No, um, she use her...what she call it?
"Secret woman weapon"? And then—

Anyway, this enough people, right? "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Insect
Meet and Greet<CLT=cltNORMAL>" is off to smashing start!

Yeah, sure. This is good enough. We should
move on to the main event anyway.
Gonta, don't be deceived!
He just used you to abduct us all!
Huh!? Really!?

Nooo, this is for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Insect Meet and Greet<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
I like bugs even more than you do, Gonta.

...Oh? More than Gonta? Amazing...
You like bugs that much...!?

It would appear...further argument is 
a useless endeavor.

Now, Gonta... Go ahead and teach them just
how wonderful bugs are.

I gotta run an errand, but I'll be back.
Don't let them leave, okay?

If they try to leave, it means you gotta really
show them why bugs are so great.
...Mm-hm, got it.
W-Wait, you're leaving!?

Of course. Someone's gotta break into your
rooms to get the <CLT=cltSTRONG>goods<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Nee-heehee... Lock picking is a cinch for an
evil supreme leader like me.

What? You're going to enter a girl's room 
without permission?

It seems I must be the one to take care of this.
With <CLT=cltSTRONG>my talent<CLT=cltNORMAL>, Kokichi, I will stop—

Yeah, yeah. I don't have time to listen to
some robot.

Let's see...it's exactly 9 p.m. right now.
I should be back by nighttime.
Welp! Have fun with the bugs till then!
<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi then left the classroom.

Kehehe... It appears we are caught 
in Kokichi's trap.

Wh-What should we do? At this rate, it'll end
up as a motive video screening party.

M-My <CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL> is no match for Gonta's
superhuman strength either...

...We still have a chance when Kokichi
comes back.

That's when I will take care of this.
Everyone, please just endure it until then.
E-Endure it—

Okay! Now we start the fun-fun "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Insect
Meet and Greet<CLT=cltNORMAL>"!

<CLT=cltMIND>When I had first woken up...
Kokichi told me this was hell.
<CLT=cltMIND>It appears that wasn't a lie.

<CLT=cltMIND>The incredible specimens each gave off
the appearance of vigor and vitality.

<CLT=cltMIND>And they were exactly as vigorous
as they looked.

<CLT=cltMIND>With our escape route blocked off, all we
could do was run around the room in a panic.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*ding dong, bing bong...*

<CLT=cltMIND>The nighttime announcement played.
But it didn't save us.

<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Insect Meet and Greet<CLT=cltMIND>
continued without mercy.

What happened, Kokichi!?
You said you'd be back by nighttime!

Ahhhh! Oh no! Himiko is being buried
alive by insects!
H-Himiko! Hold on!

The more you yell, the more bugs 
can get into your mou—PFTH! PFTH!

<CLT=cltMIND>Finally, when our bodies were completely
exhausted and sleep was nearly upon us...

What are Kokichi and Gonta's true aim, 
gathering us all together in this room?

I do not think Gonta would ever decide on
his own to capture us.

What is Kokichi trying to accomplish by
taking advantage of Gonta's naivete?

Regardless, I cannot forgive his nonchalant
attitude about using people!

I couldn't stop Gonta, not even with my
Neo-Aikido...
His power is far greater than my Neo-Aikido!

Why...did it have to be this room?
It gives me the creeps...

Like I said, if you try to escape, Gonta will
just catch you again, y'know?
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>Nothing is on the screen now,
but I'm sick just looking at it.
<CLT=cltMIND>A ton of insect specimens are on display...

<CLT=cltMIND>It covers the entire wall!
I really feel the obsession...

<CLT=cltMIND>...There are a lot of books here.
They all seem to be related to insects.

<CLT=cltMIND>Wow...
That...is an extraordinary amount of bug cages.

<CLT=cltMIND>If all these hatch...
there'll be bugs all over the academy!

<CLT=cltMIND>Releasing all these bugs
in a new world...
<CLT=cltMIND>...It's almost like Noah's Ark.

Like I said, if you try to escape, Gonta will
just catch you again, y'know?
